title: Detroit + Wada Diaspora Hub
problem: Detroit is a great American city that has decayed.  Crime, low wages, healthcare shortfalls , and poor education been devastating.
solution: Blockchain and emerging tech offer new opportunities for Detroiters. A Wada Hub will bring exposure to the DLT and the Cardano ecosystem.

title: Personal Identity Management
problem: In the metaverse you are who you want to be and you need to manage your identities.
solution: An HD wallet base identity solution to manage your online presence and authentication.

title: The Littercoin Stake Pool
problem: People are earning Littercoin but the token needs value for retailers to accept it.
solution: The Littercoin Stake Pool will accumulate rewards in a Smart Contract to give each Littercoin value.

title: Fractional minting application
problem: Game developers need NFT-based systems and tools that are audited, certified, and battle-tested.
solution: Iterative Alchemy Labs will build an open-source plug-and-play fractional minting tool based on the Fracada protocol.

title: Cardano Hub West Africa
problem: There is a limited Cardano community in west Africa. People lack awareness of Cardano as an option;  as well as the business opportunities.
solution: Fund A Cardano Hub in West Africa. will host regional events and provide educational workshops, delivered by local community members.

title: Africans acquiring ADA through USSD
problem: Over 50% of Africans still use non-smart phones. However, most crypto exchanges in Africa are only accessible through smart devices.
solution: We have built one of the first USSD-based crypto platforms that enables Africans to buy, sell, send, invest, and borrow in crypto/ADA.

title: SOIL: Semantic E-Commerce
problem: Categorizing and searching for relevant products is hard.
solution: The SOIL ecosystem uses crowdsourcing and AI to categorize and innovate products.

title: Cryptocurrency Exchange for Africa
problem: Lack of a cryptocurrency exchange that supports trading in native fiat currency in Ethiopia, Eritrea, Ghana, Zimbabwe, Djibouti, Rwanda.
solution: A cryptocurrency exchange that supports trading in native fiat currency for all African countries.

title: Mobilize NFT groups via DAO tooling
problem: NFTs offer an exciting new way to structure governance and access, but they're restrained by limited functionality.
solution: Fungify's NFT liquidity pools and governance contracts will enable exploration of novel governance models and empower NFT groups on Cardano.

title: WEB3 - Image annotation phone-app
problem: Image annotation should be affordable. But in the countries usually doing A.I. research $3/hr is not enough to satisfy a local annotator.
solution: Phone-app that pays the equivalent to $3/hr in AGIX to an image annotator in a country where $3/hr is a decent salary.

title: Cardano Creatives Swarm community
problem: There is a lack of incentives and environments to allow blockchain use cases a direct interaction with cultural and artistic initiatives.
solution: Exploring and establishing an environment of social and cultural inclusion to support, facilitate and generate culture and arts movements.

title: Science Hyperspace on Cardano
problem: Science always had problems with organisation, references, access and accessibility. There is no safe space to store knowledge of humankind.
solution: Creation of a hyperspace that links decentralized data storage with decentralized ID management: to verify, cross-reference and organise.

title: Survey+Lobbying of Japanese Law
problem: There is no comprehensive survey of Japanese law and no organization to oppose some of the reported excesses of the legal system.
solution: A Comprehensive Survey of Japanese Law + Send at least two letters of opposition to excessive legal systems

title: Japanese Cardano Crash Course Video
problem: Japanese interest in crypto and blockchain technology is growing, but many are still hesitant to invest or participate in a community.
solution: Produce a master class video in Japanese that introduces blockchain and crypto fundamentals, before showcasing what Cardano has to offer.

title: Surface Abstraction Encoding
problem: Counterfeits of real-world art are difficult to discern, as would be tokenized ownership verification.
solution: Abstractive Encoding scans real-world objects into tokenized ownership with mathematical proofs assisted by pattern-matching AI.

title: Ledger Live Integration
problem: Ledger users need to rely on 3rd party wallets to manage their ADA, this causes confusion and increases the likelihood of users being hacked
solution: Add support for ADA and Cardano Native tokens to Ledger Live enabling ADA holders to manage their digital assets from one application.

title: A world map of green Cardano
problem: Blockchain technology requires energy and is considered harmful to environment. It is difficult to identify green stakepools and offsets.
solution: A world-map based on a database showing which Cardano stakepools are already running on renewable energy or offsetting their emissions.

title: Win-Win Prism DID Integration
problem: Win-Win, a new alternate dispute resolution marketplace powered by Cardano, needs a mechanism to trustfully connect mediators with clients.
solution: Integrate Win-Win with Atala Prism so that mediators can be verified by DIDs and universities can issue credentials to their graduates.

title: Catalyst-Coordinator Hub
problem: Proposers funded by Catalyst lack a collaborative layer to answer FAQ questions, leave feedback and raise issues.
solution: Implement a collaborative layer, a community hub, to welcome funded proposers to Catalyst and provide support.

title: Wall of Gum - A Novel Virtual Place
problem: Ported dApps are coming - Cardano needs home-grown, one-of-a-kind dApps to serve our awesome community. We will need fun dApps beyond DEXes!
solution: Wall of Gum is the world's first decentralized gum wall. Gum balls are stuck to wall slots creating NFTs. Plutus contract enables trading.

title: Self Governed Gaming [Revelar+Duo]
problem: Identify verification and asset ownership confirmation in NFT games can be facilitated with decentralized IDs.
solution: Using Atala PRISM assets can be tied to players instead of wallets and the anonymous nature of the blockchain ecosystem is maintained.

title: 2MIN REVIEW Integrated Platform
problem: Voters need an integrated platform for accessing Catalyst's contents which are filtered, analyzed by 2Min Review.
solution: Building an integrated platform and mobile application for accessing Catalyst's contents which are filtered, analyzed by 2Min Review

title: DID for Music Business Backend
problem: We're building a music streaming platform. Not anyone can upload, or it will be the Wild West. Only vetted record labels. We need DID.
solution: We need to leverage Atala Prism to power this DID service and create a walled garden around licensed copyrighted content.

title: Platform for Cardano Solar Farms
problem: San Juan is one of the poorest areas of Argentina LATAM, with highest sun exposure, lack of water and energy lead to poor living conditions.
solution: Create a Platform allowing investors participate in the project through GREEN token (represents X watts of energy) on Cardano Network

title: Paperless Cross-Border Trade
problem: Developing countries face challenges realizing the massive benefits of paperless-trade due to the high price tag of software and expertise.
solution: Moving the TradeTrust interoperability framework to Cardano to facilitate low cost trusted interoperability of electronic trade documents.

title: Accelerator in Emerging Markets
problem: Funded projects based in emerging markets from F6 need to grow their companies besides product and blockchain development.
solution: Run an acceleration program by Seedstars for selected funded projects globally.

title: Carbon Footprint Ledger
problem: How can we mitigate our Carbon footprint using ADA and avoid greenwashing?
solution: Calculate your carbon footprint and send ADA to trusted projects to mitigate it

title: DAO addressing Digital Divide
problem: Telecom infrastructures are large projects that need to involve population in their governance for community network initiatives.
solution: Create a DAO with smart contracts that has the possibility to influence the direction (market, impact, etc.) of large connectivity projects.

title: Newcomer Resources en Español
problem: Cardano Education, News & Resources for NEWCOMERS is scarce in any language - & esp. Spanish! Need to provide good info for everyday people.
solution: Library of original educational articles and news in Spanish, to include Cardano basics, current events, and insights for newcomers.

title: Grow MALTA, Grow Europe !
problem: Malta is a small nation actively influencing the EU regulation, which is largely shaped in Brussels. Cardano is not yet sufficiently visible
solution: We have excellent access to universities and domain experts in Malta (and Brussels). Our goal is to establish a community-hub in Malta.

title: Friends of Cardano (US Chapter)
problem: We aren't organized to objectively engage in policy discussions, thus iterative news cycles sow fear, uncertainty and doubt.
solution: Create a space to disseminate and analyze Federal policies, and assess impact on Cardano communities.

title: Collaborat'n for global risk issues
problem: World is rife with existential risk issues, with no ways to orchestrate communities to develop solutions that address it head on.
solution: Cultivate community facilitation for engagement and proposal development aimed at tackling major issues consciously.

title: 2MinReview by Voice for Busy Voters
problem: There is a challenge for busy voters to catch the increasing information of proposals, affecting the development of the Cardano Community.
solution: Producing short English videos and podcasts lasting 2 minutes containing analyzed information for 25% of the proposals in each Catalyst Fund

title: Catalyst Circle Treasury Management
problem: Catalyst Circle needs to pay operating costs and Circle members for duties performed. Transactions need to be documented and managed.
solution: Build a system that makes CC operations frictionless and auditable when it comes to resource allocation.

title: Cardanomonitor
problem: As the Cardano ecosystem and SPO role grow, there is a need for new infrastructure and services.
solution: Cardanomonitor will be open-source analytics platform for Cardano blockchain with focus on business and some new features

title: StoryTime - A Writers Marketplace
problem: Writers are subjected to unfair treatment as a result of their views and stories. Their freedom and rights are often at risk.
solution: We want to create a marketplace for them to sell their work and be fairly compensated in a decentralized safe environement via a DAPP.

title: Supply chains for industry 5.0
problem: Today's global trade is complex and costly. Efficient coordination, security and reliable data are required for their proper operation.
solution: SIMEL connects companies and institutions to Cardano's blockchain network. The result is a better, faster and more cost-efficient trade.

title: Children write African stories
problem: African children in marginalized areas do not have the opportunity to use digital tools to tell their own stories
solution: Give children an opportunity to use digital tools to write, their own  stories in their  own languages on an open sourced digital library

title: Loxe Inc. Plutus Internship Program
problem: There are almost no internship programs for university students to get involved with Cardano, learn Haskell and Plutus.
solution: Provide new Plutus developers with mentorship and real world working experience.

title: GameChanger CLI: ready2use outputs
problem: gamechanger-dapp-cli tool is able to generate URL and QR codes, but it doesn't provide ready-to-integrate snippets for HTML, react, node...
solution: We propose to extend current URL and QR code generation from GCScripts, with plain HTML, React and Nodejs snippets.

title: Bridge Builders Mentorship Program
problem: There is a lack of professional, community driven initiatives to help Funded Proposers building their projects in an professional manner
solution: Building a Community Team of Experts, able to offer Expertise, Guidance and Mentorship for Funded Proposers to move to the next level

title: Gaming dApp Hackathon
problem: Many Ethereum developers do not know they can deploy their contract on Cardano through Milkomeda
solution: We will host a virtual hackathon for individuals & companies in the blockchain games domain and share our knowledge about Cardano & Ethereum

title: Dokurizi - decentralised journalism
problem: Good Journalism has been disrupted and battered by "fast content" on social media, heavy censorship and falling subscription numbers.
solution: DOKURIZI is a self-publishing platform for journalists where their work can be minted as NFTs. Enabling them to connect with communities.

title: Catalyst Audit Circle
problem: Catalyst lacks a governing circle whose focus is on problem sensing prioritisation of problems surrounding auditing for funded proposals.
solution: Establish a Catalyst auditing circle to guide improvements needed to maximise each funding rounds return on intention.

title: New d-EdTech Platform for LatAm
problem: Millions of people in LatAm are affected by low standards and unequal distribution of education, and the precariousness of the job industry.
solution: EdTech platform that incentivizes participation to promote growth in a technology oriented educational landscape, and relevant job industry.

title: @chain-lib Cardano API Plugins
problem: Current chain-lib/cardano-api only lets users use blockfrost. A plugin system should be made to let anyone modify the program as needed.
solution: Create a plugin system for chain-lib/cardano-api, starting with a way to get off-chain data, with blockfrost being an official first plugin.

title: African Blockchain Centre for Devs
problem:
Lack of trained Cardano developers worldwide
Acknowledgment/credibility of African devs
African brains trot to the Western countries
solution:
Train elite Cardano devs in Africa
Establish the best Cardano solution provider in Africa
Build technical elite of the future Africa

title: Metahagane - NFT Trading card game.
problem: Game development is highly centralised with one team deciding every object, asset, character structure and storyline within their creation.
solution: Metahagane decentralises the creation of gaming assets,  allowing players to create NFT objects to be used within their Metaverse.

title: NFTs for a better world
problem: NFT technology enables new ways to empower people to contribute to a better world. But most projects focus solely on visual development
solution: Using NFTs to share growth and sustainability-oriented content while facilitating a platform and community network for others to do the same

title: NFT market place to metaverse
problem: Nfts these days on cardano are mostly pfps. An alluring nft economic idea that attracts a lot of users that funnel to a growing ecosystem
solution: We have developed  cnfts with functionality on a platform setup to be integrated for mass nft launches.

title: Open Source Social Account Verifier
problem: It shouldn't be so hard to verify someone's control of a social account, email, etc; exchange info; and limit platform silos and censorship.
solution: To take the first step toward decentralized profiles; let's create the first open source, proof-of-control issuers using Atala.

title: DAO-NET: Sybil Defense DAO
problem: Sybil-resistant anonymous authentication is a common challenge for DAOs however there are no open source solutions or services on Cardano.
solution: Create a DAO to develop secure, open source Sybil-resistant anonymous authentication solutions for DAO Net and other DAOs.

title: DAO-NET: DAO Deployment Platform
problem: There is a lack of frameworks and tools to create and manage a decentralized autonomous organizations in Cardano blockchain.
solution: Create a DAO to develop a secure, open source customizable DAO solution that can be offered as a service to non-technical communities.

title: Eastern Town Hall & Japan
problem: The Japanese Community needs an fast and safe onboarding experience into Project Catalyst.
solution: The Eastern Town Hall creates a center of gravity for the japanese community. We provide a fast and safe "tailor made" onboarding structure

title: Spread Plutus through Africa
problem: Most projects in Africa avoid integrating on Cardano given the sharp learning curve that smart contracts and Plutus bring to the developers
solution: Equip and train African developers through Wada's Cameroon hub to master smart contract implementation using Plutus.

title: SCAMADA SOS
problem:
Scams are everywhere and we want to help those who get trapped and fall into a scam.
A simple solution to a big problem.
solution:
Become a new version of yourself embracing your own mistakes.
Finding support right after you've been scammed.
Coping with ones emotions.

title: Creating a Bilingual Website Hub
problem: There are not enough websites directly connecting the English and Japanese speaking Cardano communities with needed information and links.
solution: We will create a website that hosts text and video in both languages and offer "bounties" for content, along with monthly Zoom calls.

title: Nation-ready scalability research
problem: For nations to adopt blockchain, we need to achieve scalability at a nation scale
solution: We will perform novel research on a scalability solution called "naive rollups" or sometimes called "lazy rollups"

title: Cardano Totem: Onboarding the World
problem: Users living in under-developed areas stand to benefit from Cardano the most. Yet lack the infrastructure to use this new technology.
solution: A counter-top device for on-boarding, which prints a paper wallet. Using this receipt a user can interact with Cardano in a central location

title: No-Code SSI SaaS for mass adoption
problem: Adoption of SSI is low because people have no easy tools for creating interoperable & goal-oriented credential workflows.
solution: Add support of Atala PRISM to our proven no-code SSI SaaS platform to easily build, deploy & use credentials in goal-oriented interactions.

title: The Climate Change Lottery
problem: Most people would like more action taken to fight climate change[1] but it needs to be done in a fun and engaging way
solution: Incentivize people to take action by setting up a lottery where 50% of the rewards goes towards fighting climate change

title: Smart Contract Library - Phase 1
problem: Cardano lacks an open source library of smart contracts that developers can use for rapid prototyping.
solution: Build and publish a series of smart contract templates, similar to Ethereum's OpenZeppelin, that Cardano developers can utilize.

title: Mereb
problem: Mentors needed for the project catalyst community start ups
solution: To create a platform to make a better interaction between mentors, entrepreneurs and startups for the Catalyst.

title: Strategy Framework - AIM
problem: The proposal ecosystem is vast and no one strategy fits all, especially for evolving tech like Cardano
solution: Research, analysis, and evaluation of the Catalyst ecosystem, develop bespoke, custom dedicated strategies ready for implementation

title: Voted Targets 2222
problem: Community leaders and elected officials need activist driven targets with a realistic achievement date,  to address local and global matters
solution: Citizens vote on activist targets via a Dapp, target achievement dates can extend  from 1 to 200 years from 2022. Incentivised with a token

campaign.label: F7: Grow Latin America, Grow Cardano

title: Building a relevant community
problem: A low adoption of Cardano in Latin America's Real Estate private sector.
solution: Building a relevant community to motivate the adoption of Blockchain and Cardano in the private sector.

title: DAPP SDK - Tragedy of the Commons
problem: Tragedy of the commons is an economic theory that occurs on "free" resources and leads to resource ownership or policy to protect resources.
solution: Policy making and ownership decision making is difficult to make right in many countries as power may often tip the scale.

title: Roadmap to Creating a Legal Entity
problem:
Entrepreneurs need a legal structure for tax & accounting and to raise VC funds. 
Tax and accounting professionals lack crypto experience.
solution: Document how to create a legal entity used for accounting, tax, and financial purposes for an entrepreneur being paid in ADA.

title: real estate sector lacks a DEFI
problem: The real estate sector lacks a DEFI solution.
solution: Create a DAO project to provide loans and financial solutions to the real estate sector.

title: Farmers Digital Identity Initiative
problem: The lack of ID infrastructure limits accessibility to financial services for small-scale farmers in Ethiopia
solution: We are leveraging Atala Prism to  provide transaction-linked digital IDs for farmers and simplify identity verification

title: Social Mobile Game powered by CNFTs
problem: Simple but important low hanging fruits use cases are underused to expose gamers to the ecosystem. Particularly mobile and social games.
solution: Build a compelling mobile game that brings gamers to the ecosystem. Use Twitter integration for the social element and exposure.

title: Cardano/Lokole Network integration
problem: Nearly about 40% of the world population is not connected to internet. Very difficult for this population to access Cardano system.
solution: We have built an off/online portable web and email network called "Lokole" to help connect the unconnected.

title: KONMAHOOD - Defining Communities.
problem: A true democratic community platform to learn, synergize & share opinions can only exist in a decentralized space. Problem? It doesn't yet.
solution: Konmahood is where we plan to build strong communities governed by the DAO. An exclusive space for users to form tribes, learn and be free!

title: Cardano for Species Management
problem: Numbers of endangered species continue to rise, and no easy way currently exists to support efforts utilizing opportunities in blockchain.
solution: We will provide an in-house platform enabling users to support wildlife conservation through a native token, fundraising platforms & NFTs.

title: Mission& Vision driven SPO Networks
problem: Pools set up to support the building of the Catalyst community & infrastructure are underrepresented in the ecosystem.
solution: Create an innovative network of Catalyst-focused SPOs, work with prominent Catalyst builders & document their SPO journey.

title: Create Teaming Agreement Templates
problem: Catalyst funds teams of strangers working together as unincorporated entities without formal agreements defining rights or liabilities.
solution: Create template(s) suitable to serve as teaming agreements tailored to Catalyst funded proposals.

title: Cardanobi.io
problem: There's a great deal of value locked in the data processed by Cardano and its ecosystem. How to extract it and make it available to all?
solution: Build a Business Intelligence API Layer to provide on-chain analytics and enable new data-driven services on Cardano.

title: BioCrypTricks (A Human 2.0 Project)
problem: AI can enhance our human capabilities. We don't own and control our data. We're not capturing our own data. No data. No power over use of AI
solution: Collect, store & give the users control over their data using blockchain, games & test centres. Process data for them to harness AI benefits

title: Translation for Proposal API DATA
problem: We're building an API to easy query and audit all of catalyst proposal data and metrics that will only be available in English.
solution: Add a step to the current proposal api to translate data using machine learning. Set aside a fund to incentivize human validators.

title: Simple fund management DAO SDK
problem: SDKs that make it easy for builders to easily build quality tools and solutions are still limited.
solution: An opensource self-hosted or Dandelion powered typescript SDK for creating a fund management DAO. Rules DSL that govern money in and out.

title: NFT Vetted Calendar
problem: In the flood of new NFT projects, it's time consuming and hard to decide which NFT projects are solid and worth investing in.
solution: We will provide a vetted drop calendar and articles, where only researched projects that fulfil certain criteria will be included.

title: A Second-Chance Cardano Hub
problem: Ex-Offenders are locked out of many ways to earn a good living. ~77% of former prisoners are rearrested in five years.
solution: Development on blockchains offers a fresh start way to earn money and contribute. We will host a Cardano hub inside of our program @ 1426.

title: ADA Holder Engagement Survey - AIM
problem: Catalyst requires a broad, global base of engaged voters for the decentralized governance experiment to succeed.
solution: Create incentivized surveys to obtain info from a statistically significant number of voters and distribute this data to guide improvements.

title: Atala PRISM tools for web apps
problem: People use popular web frameworks without the decentralized identities' functionalities to build blogs, shops, etc for the web every day.
solution: Develop a Python package which would facilitate DIDs verification for the Flask, Django web frameworks

title: Tutorials and Hackathon
problem: There aren't a lot of AI services in the SingularityNet marketplace.
solution: Create a website with instructional videos, an active development community, problem  & solution think tank, and a hackathon with prizes.

title: PACE: Community credentials 2
problem: There is a lack of bottoms up community focussed credentials that help with both the adoption and education of Atala PRISM
solution: Community project based learning exercises for a bottoms up approach to implementing, learning about and using verifiable credentials

title: Native Tokenomics Template
problem: Industry and business projects often do not understand how Cardano Blockchain features and functions can be used efficiently
solution: A general tokenomics concept, well described and provided with practical examples, should act as a guiding template for interested parties

title: NFT Verification Tool (Open-Source)
problem: There is a lack of community driven, open source tools, resources and standards to further develop the NFT industry on Cardano.
solution: A collaborative and aligned approach and process to explore and establish tools, standards and resources to generate value for Cardano NFTs

title: MLabs DDAO
problem: DApp development on Cardano involves several challenges for developers and community builders.
solution: MLabs will implement a governance protocol that is configurable and modular. Our protocol can be deployed to create a DAO for communities.

title: Android SDK
problem: Mobile devs who want to integrate Cardano, have to build their own replica of tools, which requires knowledge of cryptography.
solution: Create a software development kit for Android. Lay a foundation for building mobile Cardano apps without knowing cryptographic internals.

title: Interoperable platform
problem: How do get African based money transfers to be interoperable with ADA and the Cardano blockchain
solution: Get a plugin that will enable interoperability between blockchain and traditional money transfers like Mobile money.

- Free workshops about Smart Contract and Plutus

title: Opensource PHP SDK for COTI ADA Pay
problem: PHP is used by over 75% of all the websites but there is no high quality Cardano native SDK for supporting ADA Payment.
solution: Create a PHP SDK (batteries included), wrapped with a Laravel & Woocommerce plugin for adding ADA Pay to any Laravel or Wordpress site.

title: Ekphrasis Gitbook
problem: Documentation of philosophical debate and discussion around Cardano requires support to be sustainable.
solution: Resource the documentation of philosophical debate and discussion around Cardano.

title: Virtual Billboard
problem: People are buying land and more on the blockchain. Users can advertise these assets and more within the Metaverse with virtual billboards.
solution: We will develop a programmatic ad selling platform with bespoke settings where buyers can advertise assets and services virtually.

title: Rarety - SC based NFT drop platform
problem: There is no smart contract based CNFT drops platform for new projects to launch.
solution: We are developing a smart contract based CNFT drop platform that also supports trading along with royalties to support artists.

title: Cardano in Spanish
problem: Lack of official Spanish content for the Cardano Project
solution: Provide translated videos in Spanish educating and keeping Hispanic community informed about the Cardano Project

title: Incrypture - Smart Structure
problem: Securitization addresses a miss-match between the needs of lenders & borrowers but the current solution benefits the middlemen instead.
solution: Securitization incentivized by tokenomics directly benefits borrowers; even small ones in developing markets not served by Wall St.

title: Dollar-Cost Averaging DApp
problem: DCAing into crypto projects manually or via exchanges, is tediously, boring, expensive (fees), centralized and non private (via exchanges).
solution: A DApp on Cardano can auto DCA for you, according to your parameters (frequency, crypto, etc ..), while being cheaper, decentralized, staked

title: Monitoring solution for a node
problem: Most SPOs use gLiveView to track the node status (requires access to the cmd line) or prometheus/graphana, where is lack of essencial data
solution: We are developing a client/server solution to track key parameters of the node/server and send notifications to a special node operator app

title: AI Resolution of Smart Contracts
problem: Resolving smart contracts often depends on centralized data sources, non-experts & those with conflicting incentives.
solution: Use AI (particularly ML) to evolve models for oracle data selection and verification with timely resolution and correctness incentives.

title: ADA 4 Science
problem: Science corruption and fundings have forced our public policies & laws to a high level of biased and tailored policies. it needs to change.
solution: Science is becoming the most important source of evidence for Governments and expert advisors when developing Public Policies.

title: Geneva Business Development Hub
problem: Impact finance and impact entrepreneurship are strong in Geneva, how to improve catalyst/Cardano collaboration?
solution: Collaborate with local players (i.e. sfgeneva.org, Seedstars, Impacthub) to promote finance and impact on Catalyst and Cardano

title: Virtual Portal: Decentralized Place
problem: Games relay on centralized service to establish a virtual environment to communicate and hang on. Why not establish it using Cardano?
solution: Using cardano blockchain to estabish a virtual environment for gamers to hang out with in a decentralized manner.

title: Anti-counterfeit B2B ecosyst Africa
problem: IIIegal goods in Kenya is estimated @USD8.26Billion in 2018. 23.37% of this is in building, mining & construction industry.Africa is bigger.
solution: Develop a fully secure supply-chain system blockchain B2B markekplace for banks to make ADA payments for only legally product to end-users.

title: Informal sector asset tracker
problem: Subsistence farmers and informal sector operators need proof of asset or goods  transfer and subsequent proof of asset ownership (PoAO)
solution: A phone Dapp using a photo image of the item with associated value.  Phone to phone asset transfer with an option for PoAO on a blockchain.

title: Crypto4Europe advocacy in Brussels
problem: Legal uncertainty hinders the development & adoption of crypto; regulators should provide clarification but lack industry link
solution: Creation of EU crypto advocacy firm & lobby forum in Brussels (EU); help stakeholders in the crypto-asset space and be SPOC for knowledge

title: Distributed storage Infrastructure
problem: Maintaining an IPFS infrastructure is time-consuming and costly.
solution: We provide easy to use HTTP API and SDK for IPFS storage.

title: Cardano Savings & Loan - PoC
problem: The Cardano blockchain needs more investing and savings options for ADA holders who wish to earn rewards or interest on their holdings.
solution: A Cardano bank that will allow holders to deposit their ADA and earn interest that will exceed what they can receive in a stake pool.

title: Konma Upskill
problem: India being a multi-lingual country with the 2nd largest population,education about Cardano in native languages can build a strong community
solution: Konma Upskill aims to create multilingual content and provide education in a language comfortable for them in an online and offline model.

title: East Africa Cardano Innovation Hub
problem: Since there is no hub for coordination and space for Cardano enthusiasts to collaborate, it is limiting the growth of Cardano in East Africa
solution: A Hub designed for collaboration; to allow people to share experiences, learn from one another and outsource or seek for talent.

title: DAO-NET: Multilingual Translation
problem: Translating and creating multilingual platforms requires sustained funding however Catalyst funding is for specific projects.
solution: Create a DAO, with sustained funding for translators, to provide translations for software interfaces, documentation, meetings and videos.

title: Townhall Channel in Vietnamese
problem: Strategy info from the weekly Cardano Townhall has not promptly reached the majority of Vietnamese and avoid mis/disinformation.
solution: After 2 and 6h from the main Townhall, a 5 mins brief and 30 mins summary Podcast versions in Vietnamese ready for commuters, TL;DR users.

title: KYC Verified Credential Issuer
problem: How can projects comply with Know Your Customer regulations?
solution: Implement and agent that delivers a Verifiable Credential to a validated identity from a trusted resource

title: FinancialTimes Startup Competition
problem: Ideas and talent exist everywhere, not just in the Silicon Valley. Capital, business support, and access to networks, on the other hand, not
solution: Create a global startup competition for funded projects to gain visibility and meet mentors and investors while receiving financial support.

problem: E-Commerce is still developing in many regions of Latin America
solution: Promote the SOIL E-Commerce platform to foster entrepreneurship and Cardano recognition.

title: Decentralized Music Platform LatAm

solution: complimentary proposal for community DAO and lobby lawmakers to legislate a blockchain enabling legal framework.

title: Decentralised Dating Application
problem: Online dating has become essential to our society but centralized dating apps fail at helping people find suitable romantic partners.
solution: create a blockchain registry & engine which connects profiles sharing high levels of complementary attributes and commonalities.

title: Proposals Mentors Marketplace -Cont
problem: Can the Proposal Mentor Marketplace offer skilled mentors to funded Catalyst Projects.
solution: Build out further capacity to the PMM to offer assistance to funded Catalyst Projects.

title: Add a calender for community events
problem: It can be hard to stay across all the events that are happening within the community and also know what events are upcoming.
solution: Develop a calendar for the community, one that is easy to add to and easy to susbcribe to and access.

title: Trust Funds by Ada
problem: Creating a Trust is expensive and complicated.As wealth is created in the blockchain ecosystem people will need ways to share and manage it.
solution: A smart contract that implements a financial Trust on the Cardano Network that delegates and distributes your tokens as you describe.

title: Automated funding catalyst projects
problem: The Catalyst support team is funding proposals manually, This mechanism requires a lot of time and effort
solution: Our proposal aims to use smart contract for Catalyst funding. Dapp is designed to release ADA per certain period of time with conditions

title: Start Haskell Community: Beginners
problem: Most Developers in Nigeria do not have the knowledge of Haskell and entry to build Dapps on Cardano. We will build a community.
solution: We will build a community of Haskell Developers by partnering with hubs, training beginners from 0 to Hero level in Haskell.

title: Trustful Global Projects
problem: Developers and clients want to work successfully together, but making agreements or payments internationally is complicated.
solution: Provide a platform for automated, tamper-proofed and verified contract execution (payments, milestones, legal). Build trust between parties

title: Mass Cardano Education for Students
problem: Education is key to adoption and use of a service. How can we educate students in Northern Ghana about Cardano Ecosystem and its benefits?
solution: Organize community events to educate about 2,000 tertiary and high school students in northern Ghana about cardano and its benefits.

title: Ethical AI for Singularity/Cardano
problem: AI and Machine Learning systems have well-know problems stemming from hidden biases and prejudices. How to address these ethical problems?
solution: We will deploy data sets for machine learning, neural nets and Bayesian nets that (1) identify biases and (2) teach ethical standards.

title: NFT Game Assets API - [Revelar]
problem: Game designers / developers need a simple and standard process for game asset generation prior to minting.
solution: Create an API that can take bulk art assets, by layer, and create final assets and metadata (CIP-25) ready to mint.

title: Clubs+hackathons = Cardano adoption
problem: Independent or one time events do not build a continuous relationship between Cardano promoters and the target audience.
solution: Create a continuous relationship with local schools via clubs and prize driven hackathons to spark deep interest in the Cardano ecosystem

title: Wolfram Eureka Mentors for Cardano
problem: Entrepreneurship is a challenging ordeal, it requires strategic support and technical advice from an experienced team.
solution:
Wolfram partners with select startups, incubators, and accelerators to inform and advise startups.
(Please see proposal for more details.)

title: Cardano Center Poland web & socials
problem: Cryptocurrencies become more and more popular in Poland. How do we enable and encourage Polish citizen to get to know the Cardano ecosystem?
solution: We want to build a Polish Cardano Center where people find valuable data, learn about Cardano's possibilities and exchange their ideas

title: NFT Guild
problem: There is a friction of the CNFT Space & Project Catalyst. A lack of communication and collaborations forces us to build silos.
solution: Provide community events with Focus on NFT Creators and Markeplaces where ideas can find a common place to meet and to connect with Catalyst

title: Video content for CNFTHub.io
problem: Currently limited options for unbiased Cardano information
solution: Add video content to CNFTHub.io

title: Global Identity and Authentication
problem: Without identity, there is: no ownership, no economic progress, no prosperity, no legally binding actions.
solution: Provide free and solid biometric Identity, owned and controlled by the Holder, and verifiable credentials, that are accepted by the Verifier

title: Stableshift: efficient AMM exchange
problem: Low capital usage efficiency, price slippage and impermanent loss are common problems of AMM exchanges. How can we solve this in Cardano?
solution: Stableshift team is building an AMM protocol based on token portfolios, with low price slippage and high APY to attract more Cardano users.

title: DisWOCO
problem: Catalyst and Cardano needs a Distributed Worker Cooperative
solution: Create an employment cooperative that provides payroll, insurance, and other benefits for future DAOs and DisCOs.

title: https://www.cardanoworld.io
problem: There is no one combining a cardano-explorer with the projects evolving (project-explorer). There is no single point of entry, no overview.
solution: We want to evolve our services for the community by further developing https://www.cardanoworld.io and https://www.cardanoworld.io/projects.

title: Open Source for the environment
problem:
Nature is an externality of our economic system.
The quicker we can take everything from nature, the more profitable we will be.
solution:
In life. This life, everything is connected.
Connecting the environment to transactions is difficult?
Can this be done in Cardano?

title: ₳GOV: Funded Proposer Experience
problem: With exponential volume of proposals and proposers, auditing projects becomes unscalable if conducted manually.
solution: Build a platform in which proposers can create a project space, provide project updates and manage and report project status socially.

title: Cardano-Cosmos IBC Bridge
problem: Cardano needs interoperability with other blockchains. Bridges to large ecosystems can create billions of dollars in TVL. Data: [1].
solution: A Cardano IBC [2] bridge will bring interoperability with the rapidly expanding Cosmos [3] ecosystem and enable cross-chain applications.

title: Decentralized Impact Incubation
problem:
Without communities, blockchain ecosystems and decentralization could not take hold. 
We need to Build and educate a community.
solution: A decentralised governance experience through an avant-gardiste incubation program in Tunisia that aim to educate and build an eco-system.

title: Hackaton for Entrepreneurs
problem: 85% of the global population live in emerging and frontier markets and they lack information about Blockchain, Cardano, and Catalyst.
solution: Create a hackathon series for DApps with Entrepreneurs in 4 physical hubs in Emerging Markets, with the best ideas to be funded in F8.

title: SAVINGS CULTURE AMONG THE UNBANKED
problem: The unbanked have no access to friendly savings systems that encourage micro saving of $0.5-$10 per week/month regularly.
solution: Savings pooled and traded in the Crypto Markets to raise funds for livelihood, solar cash power and housing. Aim is to get them digital IDs.

title: Cardahub-Hub of services on Cardano
problem: content creator, digital assets collector...want to digitalize & bring their assets on to Cardano blockchain but they don't know how & where
solution: Providing services for those who want to digitalize and bring their assets on to Cardano blockchain, in the form of an NFT and trade them.

title: DAO-NET: SPO DAO
problem: DAO Net seeks to maintain a floor value for DAO tokens, using babel fees, however incentives are needed for SPOs to provide this service.
solution: Create DAO for Stake Pool Operators that will provide funding incentives for those willing to provide babel fee services.

title: DAO Based Travel Documents & IDs
problem: Based on their place of birth, newborns are slated for either a powerful or disempowered passport.
solution: Bornstone DAO can be used to record births on the Cardano blockchain enabling the production of limitless Blockchain passports and visas.

title: Littlefish Foundation Kiva-like DAO
problem: Limited TRUST in International Organizations, lack of transparency, and lack of involvement in fund allocation in SDG activities.
solution: A DAO inspired by kiva.org that funds SDG activists and builds opensource tech to make funding transparent, community driven and trust based

title: Factpage: Cardano fact check site
problem: Fake news and disinformation about Cardano is given strength when facts cannot be independently audited and separated from falsehoods.
solution: Archive media about Cardano using the verifiable audit trails implemented in the Orcfax oracle project and publish an explorer at fact.page

title: University/College Outreach
problem: We need to reach out to university and college students and graduates to raise awareness of Cardano and the opportunities that exist.
solution: We intend to incubate interest in the blockchain by educating them with daily zooms and assisting in proposal development with the targets.

title: Identify patterns on Transaction
problem: Detecting merchant, insider fraud in Crypto Payment system is difficult and identifying new types of risks in a timely manner is even harder
solution: ​​A Deep learning approach in Managing risk – through transaction pattern discovery to determine emerging risk in Crypto Payment behaviour

title: Stake Pool Key Documentation
problem: Stake Pool cryptographic key creation and rotation procedures are difficult to understand, even for technically-adept operators.
solution: Based on the CoinCashew SPO guilde, I intend to publish a diagram to visually document the SPO key creation process to aid understanding.

title: Establish SPO 2.0 Blueprint
problem: Cardano has an impressive number of SPOs, but not all are successful. There is also a strong narrative that it is too late to get started
solution: We will proof that it is not too late to start as SPO. Considering learnings, networking and experience we will create a SPO 2.0 Blueprint

problem: The lack of a single, easily auditable platform where people can curate, present or vote on popular initiatives.
solution: Develop a platform with the benefits of the Cardano blockchain where citizens could submit proposals, vote or curate.

problem: 85% of the global population live in emerging and frontier markets and they lack information about Blockchain, Cardano, and Catalyst.
solution: Create a partnership: Seedstars and the Cardano Catalyst School promoting their content to more than 200,000 entrepreneurs from our network.

title: Revenue Share Token Smart Contract
problem: There are currently no open source smart contracts for Revenue Share Tokens applications, which could be used by many different platforms.
solution: To build an open source smart contract for revenue sharing for Cardano DApps.

title: LATAM Industry Presentation Kit
problem: Growing the Cardano ecosystem and Cardano opportunities in Latin America's industry requires localized presentation- and training material
solution: We utilize the knowledge of our team for establishing a modular DLT/Blockchain presentation & training framework for industry

title: A Moon Based Metaverse on Cardano
problem: Space tourism is a luxury reserved for the richest 0.1% of society and there isn't a way for everyone else to experience it right now
solution: Building a moon based metaverse will allow users to virtually experience space travel and everyday lunar life

title: Token Allies, Latam Businesses
problem: In LatinAmerica, It is very hard for businesses and start ups to get quick and easy access to funding, impeding many great ideas to be real.
solution: We aim to provide a platform where businesses and start ups from LATAM will be able to easily create, manage and sell their business tokens.

title: Real world products
problem: There isnt allot of tangible items that can bring more attention to Cardano.
solution: The Digital Syndicate team, owners of Cardano Budz, are looking to create the first Blockchain Strain, called "Cardano Bud".

title: Community Pharmacy System
problem: Local Health Centers in developing communities don't have systems that can manage, monitor & dispense medical supplies.
solution: We will provide: (a) Pharmacy Information System & (b) Inventory System that government & private providers can use for better management.

title: Innovatio Crowdfunding Launchpad
problem: The Launchpads on the Cardano Blockchain DeFi ecosystem don't support projects outside the blockchain world.
solution: Develop a crowdfunding platform that accepts funding for projects outside and inside the blockchain world.

title: Catalyst Treasury Management
problem: Funded proposals require a treasury and portfolio management tool beyond spreadsheets in order to track inflows and outflows.
solution: A simple, easy-to-use dashboard for funded proposals to track monthly disbursements from Catalyst, as well as expenses and wallet balances.

title: DAO-NET: CryptoFusion Funder
problem: Project Catalyst is a series of experiments however funding experiments are not being run concurrently to speed up the evolutionary process.
solution: Create a DAO to develop an experimental funding mechanism that incentivizes communities, funders and proposers to rapidly fund new projects.

title: Decentralized Music Platform
problem: Music biz infrastructure is bloated. Spotify dictates a price for art they did not help to create. Artist should transact directly w/ fans.
solution: Direct2consumer music streaming SaaS for labels on Cardano. Peer2peer networks decentralize content & decrease overhead. Artists make more $

title: DAO-NET: Auditor DAO
problem: Making the audit process efficient distributed and transparent requires sustained funding however Catalyst funding is for specific projects.
solution: Create a DAO, with sustained funding for auditors, to audit Project Catalyst or DAO Net funded projects as directed by the community.

title: SingularityNet Asset Tracker
problem: Cardano lacks an application powered by artificial intelligence to track tokens and predict future price movements.
solution: Develop a service on SingularityNet that utilizes artificial intelligence to track tokens and other assets that trade on Cardano.

title: AKI: Agile Katalyst Intrapreneurs
problem: The current funding system requires work to be planned in advance. Rapid Funding without it requires other forms of input and accountability
solution: Design a framework which combines a development team and a group of representative stakeholders to guide and assess the work iteratively

title: Africa's reliance on donations
problem: Africa relies primarily on donations to survive although it is among the richest continents on earth. Skills and resources aim for finance
solution: To provide microfinance to small projects and promising talents through a dapp built on cardano

title: Cardano Training & Complex Networks
problem: Brazil is a nation in Latin America, and our students, professionals, and entrepreneurs are still unaware of the Cardano Blockchain Network.
solution: Promote Cardano and its consensus protocol through a comprehensive online course about Complex Network Theory and Blockchain Technology.

title: Bring Ethereum NFT users to Cardano
problem: CNFTs are popular only inside Ada community because ETH users dont have connections with Cardano NFTs. No tools for side-by-side comparison.
solution: Cardano integration with checkNFT.io service. In a single tool, ETH users will analyse ETH NFTs with CNFTs that will pull adoption from ETH.

title: Jakazi Handyman DApp
problem: We  accept mediocre service and receive mediocre service from unvetted unreliable service providers and feel helpless
solution: Develop an DApp and onboard reliable, vetted  repairs and maintenance professionals for  organizations and home owners

title: Decentralized Governance Alliance
problem:
Decentralized Gov. is in its infancy and presents a fundamental issue for DAOs.
We can offer dGov resources & expertise to attract DAOs.
solution: Establish the foundations for a  dGov research and standardization body. Grow our reputation by providing a service for the entire space.

title: Open Data Public Notary
problem: Governments around the world produce a lot of data, but it is problematic to ensure their integrity in time.
solution: Denotarious.io is a solution of storing proof-of-existence timestamps, that can be used by the citizens and its government, on Cardano.

title: NFT Picture Profile AI generator
problem: In web3, users interact via avatars and picture profiles (PP). But how can one create multiple PP-NFTs based on mood, situations, stories?
solution: An AI text-to-image generator to automatically generate NFTs from a real profile picture morphed via keywords (sad, punk, zombie, etc...)

title: Penny Lane Liverpool Philosophy Hub
problem: There is a lack of philosophical discussion at community level about Cardano, so an opportunity to engage people is being missed.
solution: Work with established community philosophy networks, to build a philosophy-based Hub and lead philosophy discussion within Catalyst.

title: Application contest for students
problem: There is quite small number of application product which use ADA or Cardano Native Asset. The new application with ADA pay is important.
solution: Sometimes student in university circle products are high quality and interesting. I think catalyst fund should promote ADA for them.

title: P2P Currency Exchange with DEFI
problem: Immigrants lose a lot of money converting underserviced currency to the USD and then converting to the currency they need  (NGN - USD - CAD)
solution: A stable coin powered fiat currency DEX that allows users exchange the currency they have for the currency they need in a P2P fashion

title: SOIL: Auditable E-Commerce
problem: Governments and E-Commerce providers need to agree on how to perform audits.
solution: Create sample E-Commerce templates compliant to regional audit requirements.

title: Giving DIDs and VCs a push
problem: Our industry needs Digital Identity and Verifiable Credentials now. Institutions and governments are moving too slowly. Let's fix this!
solution: By combining proven models from other projects, we will create frameworks, libraries, and an ecosystem to jumpstart the use of DIDs and VCs.

title: Haskell & Coffee ☕
problem: There are not many ways for new Haskell developers to learn and exchange knowledge with experienced devs in a decentralized ecosystem.
solution: A weekly caffeine-infused hangout to tackle code problems with Haskell in a fun and welcoming virtual environment.

title: Build NFT liquidity pools
problem: NFTs are very illiquid and there's no reliable source for price, yet these are requisite for expanding NFTs into DeFi.
solution: NFT-FT pools create a market for instant NFT liquidity and price discovery. They're a primitive needed for NFTs to be used in DeFi.

title: Konma WEB3 payment Solution
problem: The ecosystem lacks a functional crypto payment system for an ADA payment gateway in e-commerce websites.
solution: Konma Labz plans to utilize ADA pay API for seamless checkout process with crypto payment gateway using Shelly Era Wallets on e-com sites.

title: Publishers Information Hub
problem: Disinformation, malinformation may disrupt the normal operations of a community, its services or network
solution: Information Hub that lets to verify publishers' identities (DIDs), reputation and exchange alerts about scam attempts, fake theories, etc

title: University courses
problem: Business students are not exposed to Cardano and catalyst
solution: Create a course about Catalyst and make presentation (both online and real) destined to young business students

title: SPO as anti-Climate Change vehicle
problem: The climate is heating, governments + industry aren't moving fast enough. We can use the SPO structure to fund carbon sequester credits.
solution:
1. Establish stake pool as a consumer of only "Green" electricity.
2. % of rewards to purchasing high-quality Carbon Sequestration Credits.
